name: Vegetables
description: Vegetables word search puzzles fill the grid with garden produce — carrot, broccoli, spinach, pepper, squash and chard — for adults who like market English. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. Parent theme: Food; siblings include Fruits, Herbs, Kitchen and Garden. No produce-brand stickers, no timer, no account. Start in large print if you prefer bigger letters, or see how to play for a quick primer.
